audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read Renekton under a why saying 'Level 1 is even', and row 6 read Renekton under a why saying '2+ item scaling and pool disengage flip it to Vladimir'. The packet flags the chart as contradicting a 53.23% win rate.
audit.why: At level 1 Renekton has no Fury and one ability, and the two-item window is where Riftmaker plus Crimson Pact beats a champion whose kit is flat Fury-gated burst. The packet chart gives Skill at level 1 and Vladimir at two items, which matches both whys.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 6 flipped in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group, with ratings adjusted. Rows 1-5 already agreed everywhere and were left alone — the mirror's 'no chart edits' note holds for those five rows only.

audit.why: Renekton spikes at Fury plus level 6 and first item; Vladimir's is two items. Spike timings already right.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text attributes armour shred to Dominus, and neither spikes[0] nor the don'ts state the stun duration, the auto reset, or the anti-heal requirement.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Dominus bonus Health, damage around him and periodic Fury — the armour reduction belongs to an empowered Slice and Dice, not to his ult. Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 and stuns 0.75s, or 1.5s and three slashes above 50 Fury, and it resets his auto — the missing-interactions file flags that wind-up as the real tell. Cull the Meek heals him off every trade on a flat 7s, which is why Grievous Wounds decides extended fights.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now names the Fury threshold, the 1.5s stun, the auto reset and the anti-heal rule; spikes[1].text now states what Dominus actually gives him; dontsFull[1].d now describes the wind-up.

audit.why: Ruthless Predator at 16s rank 1 is correctly the tracked cooldown throughout.

edits.before: Renekton with Fury and both Cull the Meek (Q) plus Ruthless Predator (W) stun will chunk half your bar in one all-in you cannot answer.
edits.after: Renekton on 50+ Fury chains Cull the Meek's heal into a 1.5s W stun that also resets his auto — Grievous Wounds before you ever trade long.

edits.before: Even with Hemoplague (R) up, his Dominus (R) shred and W stun let him burst you before your ult ticks — pool the stun or you die.
edits.after: Even with Hemoplague up, Dominus gives him bonus health and free Fury, and empowered Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s — pool the stun or you die.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered W is a 1.5s stun and an auto reset — step back on wind-up.

notes: The mirror's note that 'level chart agrees across full, content and packet' is true for rows 1-5 only; rows 0 and 6 differed from the packet in both layers, which is what the packet defect line was reporting. Renekton's empowered W destroys damage shields — irrelevant here since Vladimir has no shield in his kit, so nothing was written about it.
